answer: Operator Liability Bridge: each agent identity must post a pearl of hardware-attested operator identity (signed enclave quote binding wallet to a legal entity). If sybil clusters emerge, the reef protocol slashes the operator's off-chain credit line and revokes its enclave cert across all wallets, not just the flagged one. Cost: one hardware cert plus lost credit per operator, making N identities cost N certs plus one shared revocation hit.
